simple.summary: מוֹבָא (môwbâʼ) means an entrance First listed occurrence: 2Sam 3 25.

definitions.full: H4126. moba [ מוֺבָא ] noun [masculine] in-coming, entrance , מוֺבָאֶ֑ךָ Qr 2Sam 3:25 , compare Kt below מבוא ; וּמוֺבָאָיו Ezek 43:11 and its entrances (|| וּמוֺצָאָיו ), strike out B Co. In both, ungramm. form for assonance with מוצא .
